title: Middle school Chinese: classical Chinese intro
description: Four lessons on common content words, function words, sentence pauses, and translation transfer into classical Chinese.
assumptions: Short classical snippets with modern gloss; answers justified by context and known meanings.
stage2goal: Translate and transfer to new snippets.
content-words.title: Common content words
content-words.goal: Match classical content words to modern meanings.
content-words.reading: 走=run, 汤=hot water, 去=leave. Classical meanings differ from modern; use context.
content-words.worked.prompt: Why does “走” mean run in “兔走触株”?
content-words.worked.fb: A rabbit running hits the stump; walking too slow.
content-words.worked.content: 兔走触株：rabbit runs into stump.
content-words.match.prompt: Match: 走 / 汤 / 去 to run / hot water / leave.
content-words.match.z.label: 走
content-words.match.t.label: 汤
content-words.match.q.label: 去
content-words.match.r.label: run
content-words.match.h.label: hot water
content-words.match.l.label: leave
content-words.independent.a.label: hot water
content-words.independent.b.label: soup
content-words.c1.a.label: go to
content-words.c1.b.label: leave
function-words.title: Function words 之乎者也
function-words.goal: Identify the role of 之/乎/者/也 in a sentence.
function-words.reading: 之 often = possessive or object; 乎 = question; 者 = the one who; 也 = judgment pause.
function-words.struggle: Without translating fully, explain how “乎” signals a question in “学而时习之，不亦说乎？”
function-words.worked.prompt: What does “乎” do in “不亦说乎”?
function-words.worked.content: 不亦说乎：is it not pleasing? 乎 marks question.
function-words.role.a.label: a place
function-words.role.b.label: the one who
function-words.transfer-role.a.label: object
function-words.transfer-role.b.label: possessive
function-words.c1.a.label: judgment pause
function-words.c1.b.label: question
pauses.title: Sentence pauses (断句)
pauses.reading: Pause between meaning units, not inside them: “学/而/时习之” groups verb and modifier.
pauses.worked.prompt: Why pause after “学” in “学而时习之”?
pauses.worked.fb: 学 is one action; 而 connects to next.
pauses.worked.content: 学 / 而 / 时习之: action, connector, action.
pauses.order.prompt: Order the reading: 读准字音 / 读懂句意 / 读出停顿.
pauses.order.s.label: 读准字音
pauses.order.m.label: 读懂句意
pauses.order.p.label: 读出停顿
pauses.transfer-pause.a.label: 温 / 故而 / 知新
pauses.transfer-pause.b.label: 温故 / 而 / 知新
pauses.c1.a.label: word count
pauses.c1.b.label: meaning units
translate.title: Translate and transfer
translate.goal: Translate a snippet using known words and context.
translate.reading: Translate word-by-word then smooth: keep known meanings, adjust order for modern grammar.
translate.worked.content: 学=learn, 时=often, 习=review, 之=it.
translate.translate.a.label: Review old and gain new
translate.translate.b.label: Warm the old
translate.transfer-translate.prompt: “知之为知之，不知为不知” teaches…
translate.transfer-translate.a.label: memorize more
translate.transfer-translate.b.label: honesty about knowing
translate.c1.a.label: known meanings
translate.c1.b.label: modern slang
translate.c2.a.label: word meanings
translate.c2.b.label: word order
